title: Default test run at lptpzxuplxky
description: The default test run (python3 lib/tools/test_costs.py run: cargo test and every Python suite, the unit and tool tiers) at change lptpzxuplxky, "The default run takes 4.6 minutes where it took 16: Rust's test binaries and the Python files run several at a time, and", queued after the run was made parallel: its first run under the job's six CPUs and 4 GB, and the first to record what it left unread. Nobody waits for it: the watcher or the next session reads the result, and sync.py push requires a passed run that covers the commit it pushes (verification/default_tests.py).
expected: exits 0: every test of the default run passes

resources.notes: the default run took about 16 minutes inline in 2026-11 (11 Rust, 5 Python), longer beside proof jobs; its cargo target directory is kept warm between runs
